The core concept, bringing real author's books to life as talking videos they can embed on their website, built from masky. It will not invtent new words except short prhases like 'I've answered this question before ... on this podcast/from this user/ etc, and I said '{transcript}'" - masky brings this to life with a voice or video experience depending on the users credits available on masky. The author earns a portion of the user credit spend, and users can easily reshare any of the small sections of the book or agent sessions to their socials. Also existing older books will be made available like the bible in a 'public domain' section within the app - the bible as our first example for this hackathon.
